description: Filing-grounded equity research workflow with bounded MCP research, ResearchState packs, selected trace/chain expansion, and Korean Markdown synthesis.

interface.shortDescription: Answer filing-grounded equity research questions from 10-K and 10-Q evidence.
interface.longDescription: Provides read-only MCP tools and research skills for KRW ontology web chat. The default path uses bounded query_context-first research, ResearchState packs, selected trace/chain verification, and Korean Markdown synthesis. Structured display planning is optional and only used when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Apple의 최근 매출 동인과 사업 구조를 공시자료 기준으로 정리해줘.
AMZN의 AWS와 리테일 매출 구조를 비교해줘.
AAPL이 특정 원자재 가격에 직접 노출되어 있는지 확인해줘.
